claim.quote: We report final results on electroweak parameters from muon-neutrino electron scattering observed in the CHARM II detector from 1987 till 1991.

date.note: Year of publication in Phys. Lett. B 335, 246 (1994), from the Sapienza repository record; the journal's own page (sciencedirect.com) returned HTTP 403 and the abstract is quoted as reproduced on the repository record.

key_value_text.quote: From the ration of differential cross sections we obtain for the electroweak mixing angle sin2 Θ = 0.2324+/-0.0083.

name: Precision measurement of electroweak parameters from the scattering of muon-neutrinos on electrons

summary.plain: CHARM II counted thousands of rare events in which a muon neutrino or antineutrino bumps an electron. From them it found the weak mixing angle to be 0.2324 with an error of 0.0083, a clean test of the electroweak theory.
summary.technical: Final results from nu_mu-e scattering in CHARM II (1987-1991 sample): 2677 +- 82 and 2752 +- 88 events in the nu and nu-bar beams; sin^2 theta_W = 0.2324 +- 0.0083 from the ratio of differential cross sections; effective couplings g_V = -0.035 +- 0.017 and g_A = -0.503 +- 0.017 from the absolute rate.

title: Precision measurement of electroweak parameters from the scattering of muon-neutrinos on electrons
why_it_matters: The most precise determination of the weak mixing angle from neutrino-electron scattering, free of the hadronic uncertainties of neutrino-nucleon measurements.
